name: photog_paige
tag: pics or it didnt happen. no really. send me the pics
blogTitle: the dutch angle is not a mistake: a defense
about: im paige. i take pictures. tilted ones. if ur at a show or a fight or a fight at a show, i was there and i have proof. i shoot film (holga, my nanas old pentax) AND digital (canon powershot, 4 megapixels, dont laugh) and everything gets cross processed in photoshop 7 til it looks like a dream about a parking lot. pc4pc always. i have never once not pc'd back.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: anyone who will let me photograph them mid-argument. also the guy at the mall camera kiosk who told me a fisheye is 'not a real lens'. i just want to talk.

interests.General: photography (obviously), my holga, the fisheye i saved 3 months of babysitting money for, tilting the camera exactly 45 degrees, cross processing, photobucket bandwidth (the enemy), being where the drama is, pc4pc, chai from the cart by the bus stop
interests.Music: death cab, the postal service, imogen heap, regina spektor, bright eyes, feist, rilo kiley, the shins, metric, tegan and sara, whatever is playing at urban outfitters
interests.Movies: garden state (and the soundtrack), eternal sunshine, amelie, lost in translation, napoleon dynamite (for the composition), elizabethtown (dont judge me)
interests.Television: americas next top model (for the photographers not the models), project runway, laguna beach (its basically a documentary), gilmore girls, the hills
interests.Books: the perks of being a wallflower, chuck palahniuk (i skimmed), the lomography manifesto (its 10 rules and i broke 4), nylon magazine, the dos and donts in vice
interests.Heroes: annie leibovitz, diane arbus, my nana who gave me her pentax, whoever invented the self timer, tom green for tilting the camera first (i think)

bulletins.subject: NEW PICS: 'gregs garage 8/28' + 'candids (u know who u r)'
bulletins.body: ok both albums are up. 63 pics in the show one, 22 in candids. everyone who said pc4pc at the show this is me holding u to it. the parking lot pics ARE in there, i blurred faces where it counts, dont ask me to take them down, its journalism. comment ur favorites. if u see a grey box that means photobucket hates me and u should refresh and try again. <3 paige

bulletins.subject: pics or it didnt happen (a manifesto) (also pc4pc)
bulletins.body: 1. if u werent photographed at the show u werent at the show. 2. if ur fighting in a public place u are in my album. 3. tilted is a style. 4. fisheye is a real lens, marcus at the kiosk. 5. i will always pc back, i have never once not pc'd back, dont test me. new pics thursday. bring ur face.
